format.continuity: One visual day and one aircraft/wardrobe/livery package after source lock.
format.delivery: Generate individual high-resolution reference frames first, then a labeled continuity sheet from approved frames.
format.runtimeUse: Reference only. Generated pixels do not enter production runtime closure.

positive: Original hand-painted mid-century animated feature language.
Gouache backgrounds with broad value-separated mountain planes.
Soft cel-shaped people and machinery with restrained edge accents.
Mechanically exact aircraft silhouette, deck equipment and damage continuity.
Large expressive weather, visible wind and human-scale inhabited land.
Warm light as a local accent inside a cool Korean atmosphere.
Affection for imperfect machinery without romanticizing weapon effects.
negative: Do not imitate a named studio, filmmaker, living artist, character design or existing film frame.
No modern carrier, angled deck, swept-wing substitute or afterburner plume.
No photorealism, glossy 3D render, anime speed lines, comic onomatopoeia or game HUD.
No heroic poster pose, Moon imagery, astronaut symbolism or retrospective destiny.
No decorative Korean script, generalized East Asian motifs or invented traditional costume.
No celebratory explosion, gore, civilian targeting or enemy caricature.
